correctness.rationale: The normal form of the restricted p-map is proven by the split mu_p/alpha_p Lie correspondence. Its zero scheme is generated by wedge coordinates X_i^p X_j-X_j^p X_i and X_i^pY_a. Charts with Y_a=1 are exactly k[y,x]/(x_1^p,...,x_r^p); charts with X_i=1 are k[x_j]/(x_j^p-x_j) with Y=0. These exhaustive charts establish disjoint decomposition and reducedness of ordinary points. The finite projection of the thick component has a graded monomial basis with transition O(-sum e_i); rank p^r, tangent dimension and Hilbert polynomial follow. A standalone Python checker verifies 27 bounded cases, not the general theorem.

value.rationale: The natural projective parameter scheme has deformation information invisible to the geometric p-closed foliation set. The theorem determines both the reduced components and their nilpotent scheme structure, general generic multiplicity p^r, tangent-space inflation and an explicit Hilbert polynomial for all split Frobenius-kernel types. The smallest mixed surface has just two points but scheme length p+1; this exhibits a tangible failure of geometric-point enumeration to capture the moduli tangent structure. This is a meaningful exact invariant for a natural infinite family, not a routine re-labeling of known point counts.
